papers.title: CSAVocoder: A Causal Spatial Audio Vocoder Towards Real-Time Spatial Audio Generation

rationale.en: CSAVocoder combines causal streaming spatial generation with explicit inter-channel supervision and reports large-scale objective, subjective, and real-time evaluations.
rationale.zh: CSAVocoder 将因果流式空间音频生成与显式跨声道监督结合，并报告了大规模客观、主观及实时性能评测。

summary.en: The paper proposes CSAVocoder, a causal GAN-based spatial audio vocoder that uses a Spatial Adaptor and a spatial consistency discriminator to generate spatial audio from mel-spectrograms with real-time performance.
summary.zh: 本文提出了 CSAVocoder，一种基于因果 GAN 的空间音频声码器，通过空间适配器和空间一致性判别器从梅尔频谱图生成空间音频，并支持实时推理。

papers.title: Arbitrary Polygon Oscillator: Generalizing Polygonal Synthesis to Arbitrary Shapes, Morphing, and Three-Dimensional Polyhedra

summary.en: The paper generalizes polygonal synthesis to arbitrary vertex configurations, unequal vertex-count morphing, and 3D polyhedra using a unified arc-length DSP engine with runtime geometric antialiasing.
summary.zh: 本文通过统一的弧长 DSP 引擎，将多边形合成推广到任意顶点配置、不等顶点数变形和三维多面体，并采用运行时几何抗混叠技术。

papers.title: Visually-Guided Spatial Audio Generation for 360° In-the-Wild Speech Scenes

summary.en: The paper introduces YT-SPEECH dataset and a Localizer-Renderer framework with a conditional complex-domain U-Net for visually-guided FOA speech spatialization from 360-degree video and omnidirectional audio.
summary.zh: 本文提出了 YT-SPEECH 数据集和一个包含条件复数域 U-Net 的定位器-渲染器框架，用于在野外场景中通过视频引导从全向音频重建 FOA 语音信号。

papers.title: FM Synthesizer Audio-Parameter Shared Embeddings

rationale.en: SynAPSE represents FM signal routing explicitly, evaluates generalization to unseen topologies with ablations, and releases inference code and pretrained models.
rationale.zh: SynAPSE 显式表示 FM 信号路由，通过消融实验评测未见拓扑泛化，并公开推理代码和预训练模型。

summary.en: SynAPSE learns shared embeddings for DX7 audio and synthesizer presets with a graph encoder that follows FM signal routing, enabling audio-to-preset retrieval and generalization to unseen routing topologies.
summary.zh: SynAPSE 使用遵循 FM 信号路由的图编码器学习 DX7 音频与合成器预设的共享表征，用于音频到预设检索并泛化到未见路由拓扑。

papers.title: Ambisonics Encoding of Room Impulse Responses using a Device-Agnostic Diffusion Model

summary.en: The paper presents a diffusion-based framework for encoding room impulse responses into high-order Ambisonics from arbitrary microphone arrays, using posterior sampling for consistency and outperforming baselines in a listening test.
summary.zh: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的框架，用于从任意麦克风阵列将房间冲激响应编码为高阶 Ambisonics，通过后验采样保证一致性，并在听感测试中优于基线。

papers.title: Beyond Dry References: Learning Relative Audio Effects Representations via Contrastive Distance Learning

summary.en: Learns relative audio-effects representations from processed example pairs and evaluates them in retrieval and effect transfer.
summary.zh: 从成对的已处理音频示例中学习相对音效表征，并评估其在检索与音效迁移中的应用。

rationale.en: Introduces relative audio-effect representations without requiring dry references, with a bidirectional design and extensive retrieval and style-transfer evaluation.
rationale.zh: 提出无需干声参考的相对音效表征，并通过双向设计及较完整的检索与风格迁移实验进行验证。

papers.title: EG-VAE: A Unified Framework for Electric Guitar Tone Transfer and Removal

summary.en: Unifies electric-guitar tone transfer and tone removal by disentangling content and tone in a variational autoencoder.
summary.zh: 通过变分自编码器解耦内容与音色，统一电吉他音色迁移和音色去除。

papers.title: Rethinking Automatic Music Mixing as Sequential Stem Blending

summary.en: Reformulates automatic music mixing as sequentially blending each stem into a growing submix.
summary.zh: 将自动音乐混音重新表述为把各音轨依次融合进不断扩展的子混音。

papers.title: Diff2Mix: Controllable Music Mixing via Diffusion Models and Differentiable Audio Effects

summary.en: Combines diffusion models with differentiable audio effects for controllable automatic music mixing.
summary.zh: 结合扩散模型与可微分音频效果，实现可控自动音乐混音。

rationale.en: Combines generative control with differentiable audio effects to provide a coherent and controllable approach to multitrack music mixing.
rationale.zh: 将生成式控制与可微分音效结合，为多轨音乐混音提供了完整且可控的方法。

papers.title: Band-Count Dense Modal Estimation with Fixed-Frequency Differentiable Resonator Refinement

summary.en: Estimates dense plate-reverb modes by combining band-wise count prediction with differentiable resonator refinement.
summary.zh: 结合分频带模态数量预测与可微谐振器细化，估计密集的板式混响模态。

papers.title: Simulation-Based Plate-Reverb Parameter Estimation from a Single Impulse Response

summary.en: Estimates plate-reverb parameters from one impulse response using simulation-trained tree regressors.
summary.zh: 使用仿真数据训练的树回归器，从单个冲激响应估计板式混响参数。

papers.title: Black-Box Optimization for Identifying and Inverting Audio Dynamic Range Control Effects

summary.en: Identifies and inverts dynamic range compression through black-box optimization in a perceptual feature space.
summary.zh: 在感知特征空间中通过黑盒优化识别并反演动态范围压缩效果。

papers.title: RIME: Enabling Large-Scale Agentic Music Post-Production

summary.en: The paper introduces RIME, a framework for generating paired edit-instruction data using POEMS (stem separation, mixing, effects) to enable large-scale agentic music post-production and evaluate multimodal LLMs on this task.
summary.zh: 本文提出了 RIME 框架，利用结合了分轨分离、混音和常用效果器的 POEMS 工具包生成配对的编辑指令数据，以支持大规模智能体音乐后期制作，并评估多模态大语言模型在这项任务上的表现。

papers.title: InstructFX2FX: A Multi-Turn Text-to-Effect System for Sequential Audio Effect Refinement

summary.en: Edits persistent audio-effect chains through multi-turn natural-language instructions and differentiable processing.
summary.zh: 结合多轮自然语言指令与可微处理，对持续保留的音效链进行编辑。

papers.title: ImmersiveFlow: Stereo-to-7.1.4 spatial audio generation with flow matching

summary.en: Uses flow matching to upmix stereo audio directly into a 7.1.4 immersive loudspeaker format.
summary.zh: 使用流匹配将立体声音频直接上混为 7.1.4 沉浸式扬声器格式。

papers.title: Gradient-based Optimisation of Modulation Effects

summary.en: Uses gradient-based optimization to estimate controls for time-varying modulation effects from target audio.
summary.zh: 利用基于梯度的优化，从目标音频估计时变调制类效果器的控制参数。

papers.title: DAWZY: A New Addition to AI powered "Human in the Loop" Music Co-creation

summary.en: DAWZY converts text, voice, or humming requests into reversible REAPER actions, using MCP tools to query DAW state, adjust parameters, and generate beats while keeping edits grounded in the current project.
summary.zh: DAWZY 将文本、语音或哼唱请求转换为可撤销的 REAPER 操作，并通过 MCP 工具查询 DAW 状态、调节参数和生成节拍，使编辑与当前工程状态保持一致。

papers.title: LLM2Fx-Tools: Tool Calling For Music Post-Production

summary.en: Uses large-language-model tool calling to select and control audio processors for music post-production.
summary.zh: 利用大语言模型的工具调用能力，为音乐后期制作选择并控制音频处理器。

papers.title: Differentiable Attenuation Filters for Feedback Delay Networks

summary.en: Designs differentiable parametric attenuation filters for frequency-dependent decay control in feedback delay networks.
summary.zh: 为反馈延迟网络设计可微参数化衰减滤波器，以控制频率相关的混响衰减。

papers.title: Automatic Music Mixing using a Generative Model of Effect Embeddings

summary.en: Generates effect embeddings for automatic music mixing, providing a learned distribution over production choices.
summary.zh: 为自动音乐混音生成音效嵌入，学习制作选择的分布。

rationale.en: Models a conditional distribution over professional multitrack mixes while supporting arbitrary unlabeled tracks and both objective and listening-test evaluation.
rationale.zh: 对专业多轨混音的条件分布进行建模，可处理任意未标注轨道，并同时提供客观评价与听感实验。

papers.title: DiffFx: A Toolkit for Differentiable Audio Effects Processors

summary.en: Provides a PyTorch toolkit of interpretable differentiable processors for effects research, mixing, mastering, and parameter matching.
summary.zh: 提供一组 PyTorch 可解释可微效果器，用于音效研究、混音、母带与参数匹配。

papers.title: Reverse Engineering of Music Mixing Graphs with Differentiable Processors and Iterative Pruning

summary.en: Extends differentiable reverse engineering of recording mixes by pruning and refining audio processing graphs.
summary.zh: 通过剪枝与细化音频处理图，扩展录音混音的可微逆向工程方法。

papers.title: Diff-DEQ: Differentiable Dynamic Equalization for Studio-Quality Speech Processing

summary.en: Uses differentiable dynamic equalization to learn studio-style speech enhancement with interpretable controls.
summary.zh: 利用可微动态均衡学习录音室风格的语音处理，并保留可解释控制。

papers.title: Neural-Driven Multi-Band Processing for Automatic Equalization and Style Transfer

summary.en: Combines a six-band parametric equalizer and per-band compression for automatic EQ and reference-guided style transfer.
summary.zh: 结合六段参数均衡与分频带压缩，用于自动均衡和参考引导的风格迁移。

papers.title: Differentiable Scattering Delay Networks for Artificial Reverberation

summary.en: Optimizes scattering matrices and absorption filters in a differentiable delay network against room impulse responses.
summary.zh: 依据房间冲激响应，优化可微散射延迟网络中的散射矩阵与吸声滤波器。

papers.title: SonicMaster: Towards Controllable All-in-One Music Restoration and Mastering

summary.en: Combines controllable music restoration and mastering in a single all-in-one generative system.
summary.zh: 在统一生成系统中结合可控音乐修复与母带处理。

papers.title: WildFX: A DAW-Powered Pipeline for In-the-Wild Audio FX Graph Modeling

rationale.en: WildFX exposes professional DAW and plug-in routing as reproducible production graphs, supports multitrack structures such as sidechains and crossovers, and releases the complete data-generation pipeline.
rationale.zh: WildFX 将专业 DAW 与插件路由转化为可复现制作图，支持侧链和分频等多轨结构，并公开完整数据生成流程。

summary.en: WildFX is a containerized REAPER-backed pipeline for generating multitrack datasets with heterogeneous commercial or open plug-in graphs, including sidechains, crossovers, and structured project metadata.
summary.zh: WildFX 是一个基于 REAPER 的容器化流程，用于生成包含商业或开源插件异构处理图的多轨数据，并支持侧链、分频和结构化工程元数据。

papers.title: MIDI-VALLE: Improving Expressive Piano Performance Synthesis Through Neural Codec Language Modelling

rationale.en: MIDI-VALLE provides a focused performance-MIDI-to-audio model with objective and listening evaluations, an official implementation, and openly downloadable pretrained checkpoints.
rationale.zh: MIDI-VALLE 面向演奏 MIDI 到音频渲染，提供客观与听音评测、官方实现以及可直接下载的预训练权重。

summary.en: MIDI-VALLE adapts a neural codec language model to synthesize expressive piano audio from performance MIDI, conditioning on paired reference MIDI and audio to improve realism and generalization.
summary.zh: MIDI-VALLE 将神经编解码语言模型用于从演奏 MIDI 合成富有表现力的钢琴音频，并通过配对的参考 MIDI 与音频改善真实感和泛化能力。

papers.title: Generating Moving 3D Soundscapes with Latent Diffusion Models

summary.en: Generates moving three-dimensional first-order Ambisonic soundscapes with a latent diffusion model.
summary.zh: 使用潜空间扩散模型生成具有运动轨迹的三维一阶 Ambisonics 声景。

papers.title: The Extended SONICOM HRTF Dataset and Spatial Audio Metrics Toolbox
papers.venue: Proceedings of the 11th Convention of the European Acoustics Association Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 2025

summary.en: Extends the SONICOM resource to 300 measured subjects with synthesized HRTFs, head scans, and a spatial-audio metrics toolbox.
summary.zh: 将 SONICOM 扩展至 300 名测量对象，并提供合成 HRTF、头部扫描及空间音频指标工具箱。

rationale.en: Substantially expands public personalized-HRTF data and pairs it with an open metrics toolbox for reproducible analysis and evaluation.
rationale.zh: 显著扩展公开个体化 HRTF 数据，并提供开放指标工具箱以支持可复现分析与评测。

papers.title: Fx-Encoder++: Extracting Instrument-Wise Audio Effects Representations from Mixtures

summary.en: Extracts instrument-wise audio-effects representations directly from mixtures for retrieval and style transfer.
summary.zh: 直接从混合音频中提取分乐器音效表征，用于检索与风格迁移。

rationale.en: Extracts instrument-wise effect representations directly from mixtures and validates them on retrieval and style-transfer tasks.
rationale.zh: 直接从混合音频中提取分乐器音效表征，并在检索与风格迁移任务上进行验证。

papers.title: ITO-Master: Inference-Time Optimization for Audio Effects Modeling of Music Mastering Processors

summary.en: Applies inference-time optimization to match music mastering processors with a differentiable effects chain.
summary.zh: 通过推理时优化调整可微分效果链，以匹配音乐母带处理器。

papers.title: ViSAGe: Video-to-Spatial Audio Generation

summary.en: Generates first-order Ambisonics from silent video using visual features, directional conditioning, and autoregressive audio tokens.
summary.zh: 利用视觉特征、方向条件和自回归音频 token，从静音视频生成一阶 Ambisonics。

rationale.en: Introduces direct video-to-Ambisonics generation together with a sizable dataset, spatial metrics, checkpoints, and reproducible code.
rationale.zh: 提出直接从视频生成 Ambisonics，并配套发布大规模数据集、空间指标、权重与可复现代码。

papers.title: Improving Inference-Time Optimisation for Vocal Effects Style Transfer with a Gaussian Prior

summary.en: Adds a learned Gaussian prior to inference-time optimization for more reliable vocal-effects style transfer.
summary.zh: 为推理时优化加入学习得到的高斯先验，以提升人声音效风格迁移的稳定性。

papers.title: ISDrama: Immersive Spatial Drama Generation through Multimodal Prompting

summary.en: Generates continuous multi-speaker binaural drama with spatial placement and expressive prosody from multimodal prompts.
summary.zh: 根据多模态提示生成具有空间布局和表现力韵律的连续多说话人双耳剧集。

papers.title: OmniAudio: Generating Spatial Audio from 360-Degree Video

summary.en: Generates spatial audio from 360-degree video while modeling sound-source direction and visual context.
summary.zh: 从 360 度视频生成空间音频，同时建模声源方向与视觉上下文。

rationale.en: Addresses 360-video spatial-audio generation with an integrated method, broad empirical comparisons, and an official implementation.
rationale.zh: 以完整方法解决 360 度视频空间音频生成，进行了广泛实验比较，并提供官方实现。

papers.title: DiffVox: A Differentiable Model for Capturing and Analysing Vocal Effects Distributions

summary.en: Uses a differentiable vocal-effects model to capture and analyze distributions of professional production settings.
summary.zh: 使用可微分人声效果模型捕捉并分析专业制作参数的分布。

papers.title: DualSpec: Text-to-spatial-audio Generation via Dual-Spectrogram Guided Diffusion Model

summary.en: Generates spatial audio from text with diffusion guided jointly by magnitude and spatial spectrogram representations.
summary.zh: 通过幅度与空间频谱图联合引导的扩散模型，根据文本生成空间音频。

papers.title: Differentiable Black-box and Gray-box Modeling of Nonlinear Audio Effects

summary.en: Systematically compares differentiable black-box and gray-box approaches for modeling nonlinear audio effects.
summary.zh: 系统比较用于非线性音频效果建模的可微分黑盒与灰盒方法。

papers.title: NablAFx: A Framework for Differentiable Black-box and Gray-box Modeling of Audio Effects

summary.en: Provides NablAFx, a common framework for developing and comparing differentiable black-box and gray-box audio-effect models.
summary.zh: 提供 NablAFx 统一框架，用于开发和比较可微分黑盒与灰盒音频效果模型。

rationale.en: Provides a reusable unified framework for differentiable black-box and gray-box modeling across multiple audio-effect families.
rationale.zh: 为多类音频效果器的可微分黑盒与灰盒建模提供了可复用的统一框架。

papers.title: Towards An Integrated Approach for Expressive Piano Performance Synthesis from Music Scores

rationale.en: S2A joins score-to-performance and performance-to-audio stages in one evaluated pipeline and releases code, checkpoints, and objective evaluation tools for both stages.
rationale.zh: S2A 将乐谱到演奏和演奏到音频两个阶段整合进同一评测流程，并公开两阶段代码、权重和客观评测工具。

summary.en: S2A combines a Transformer expressive performance renderer with a fine-tuned neural MIDI synthesizer to convert score MIDI into expressive piano performance MIDI and then rendered audio.
summary.zh: S2A 将 Transformer 表情演奏渲染器与微调后的神经 MIDI 合成器结合，把乐谱 MIDI 依次转换为富有表现力的演奏 MIDI 和最终音频。

papers.title: CCStereo: Audio-Visual Contextual and Contrastive Learning for Binaural Audio Generation

summary.en: Uses contextual and contrastive audio-visual learning to improve fine-grained mono-to-binaural generation across environments.
summary.zh: 利用上下文与对比式音视频学习，提升跨环境的细粒度单声道到双耳音频生成。

papers.title: Open-Amp: Synthetic Data Framework for Audio Effect Foundation Models

summary.en: Builds a synthetic-data framework for training broadly conditioned audio-effect and amplifier models.
summary.zh: 构建合成数据框架，用于训练具有广泛条件控制能力的音效与音箱模型。

rationale.en: Provides a scalable synthetic-data framework with broad device coverage and transfer experiments for audio-effect foundation modeling.
rationale.zh: 面向音效基础模型提供可扩展的合成数据框架，并覆盖多种设备及迁移实验。

papers.title: ST-ITO: Controlling Audio Effects for Style Transfer with Inference-Time Optimization

summary.en: Performs reference-based effects style transfer by optimizing a differentiable processor chain at inference time.
summary.zh: 在推理阶段优化可微分处理器链，实现参考引导的音效风格迁移。

rationale.en: Connects learned style embeddings to interpretable differentiable processor control through inference-time optimization without parameter labels.
rationale.zh: 通过推理时优化将学习到的风格表征连接到可解释的可微分效果器控制，且无需参数标签。

papers.title: ImmerseDiffusion: A Generative Spatial Audio Latent Diffusion Model

summary.en: Generates first-order Ambisonic soundscapes conditioned on sound-object position, timing, and environmental context.
summary.zh: 根据声对象的位置、时间与环境条件生成一阶 Ambisonics 声景。

papers.title: Diff-SAGe: End-to-End Spatial Audio Generation Using Diffusion Models

summary.en: Uses an end-to-end diffusion model to jointly generate semantic audio content and spatial information.
summary.zh: 使用端到端扩散模型联合生成音频语义内容与空间信息。

papers.title: Both Ears Wide Open: Towards Language-Driven Spatial Audio Generation

summary.en: Generates multi-object binaural soundscapes from language prompts with explicit temporal and spatial control.
summary.zh: 根据语言提示生成多声源双耳声景，并提供显式的时间与空间控制。

rationale.en: Adds language-driven spatial control to generative audio and releases a large dataset, checkpoints, inference code, and evaluation tools.
rationale.zh: 为生成式音频引入语言驱动的空间控制，并公开大规模数据集、权重、推理代码与评测工具。

papers.title: Text2FX: Harnessing CLAP Embeddings for Text-Guided Audio Effects

summary.en: Uses CLAP embeddings to translate text descriptions into controls for audio effects processing.
summary.zh: 利用 CLAP 嵌入将文本描述转换为音频效果处理控制。

papers.title: FLAMO: An Open-Source Library for Frequency-Domain Differentiable Audio Processing

summary.en: Provides frequency-domain differentiable audio modules for constructing and optimizing filters, reverberators, and processing systems.
summary.zh: 提供频域可微音频模块，用于构建和优化滤波器、混响器及音频处理系统。

rationale.en: Offers a reusable frequency-domain differentiable processing library spanning filters, reverberation, and system optimization.
rationale.zh: 提供可复用的频域可微分处理库，覆盖滤波、混响与系统优化等任务。

papers.title: GRAFX: An Open-Source Library for Audio Processing Graphs in PyTorch

summary.en: Introduces GRAFX, an open-source PyTorch library for constructing and optimizing differentiable audio processing graphs.
summary.zh: 提出开源 PyTorch 库 GRAFX，用于构建和优化可微分音频处理图。

rationale.en: Introduces an open-source graph-level differentiable audio-processing library for flexible production-chain construction and optimization.
rationale.zh: 提供开源的图级可微分音频处理库，支持灵活构建和优化制作处理链。

papers.title: Automatic Equalization for Individual Instrument Tracks Using Convolutional Neural Networks

summary.en: Predicts equalization settings for individual instrument tracks with convolutional neural networks.
summary.zh: 使用卷积神经网络为单独乐器轨道预测均衡器设置。

papers.title: Towards zero-shot amplifier modeling: One-to-many amplifier modeling via tone embedding control

summary.en: Conditions a one-to-many neural amplifier model on tone embeddings to support zero-shot amplifier modeling.
summary.zh: 利用音色嵌入控制一对多神经音箱模型，以支持零样本音箱建模。

papers.title: Diff-MST: Differentiable Mixing Style Transfer

summary.en: Uses a differentiable mixing console to transfer the production style of a reference mix to multitrack audio.
summary.zh: 使用可微分混音台将参考混音的制作风格迁移到多轨音频。

rationale.en: Demonstrates end-to-end reference mixing-style transfer with an interpretable differentiable console and broad experimental evaluation.
rationale.zh: 利用可解释的可微分调音台实现端到端参考混音风格迁移，并开展较全面的实验评价。

papers.title: SEE-2-SOUND: Zero-Shot Spatial Environment-to-Spatial Sound

summary.en: Generates spatial sound for visual environments in a zero-shot pipeline that combines scene understanding, audio generation, and spatialization.
summary.zh: 通过结合场景理解、音频生成和空间化的零样本流程，为视觉环境生成空间声音。

papers.title: Searching For Music Mixing Graphs: A Pruning Approach

summary.en: Searches and prunes differentiable music-mixing graphs to recover compact audio processing chains.
summary.zh: 搜索并剪枝可微音乐混音图，以恢复紧凑的音频处理链。

papers.title: Ambisonizer: Neural Upmixing as Spherical Harmonics Generation

summary.en: Formulates neural upmixing as spherical-harmonic generation to map lower-channel audio into Ambisonics.
summary.zh: 将神经上混建模为球谐函数生成，把较少声道的音频映射为 Ambisonics。

rationale.en: Unifies neural upmixing through spherical-harmonic generation, evaluates the formulation across channel settings, and releases the implementation.
rationale.zh: 以球谐生成统一神经上混，在多种声道设置下验证方法，并公开实现。

papers.title: MIMOSA: Human-AI Co-Creation of Computational Spatial Audio Effects on Videos

summary.en: Provides a human-AI co-creation interface that helps video creators author and edit computational spatial audio effects.
summary.zh: 提供人机共创界面，帮助视频创作者设计和编辑计算式空间音频效果。

papers.title: Differentiable All-pole Filters for Time-varying Audio Systems

summary.en: Derives efficient gradients for time-varying all-pole filters and applies them to phasers, synthesis, and dynamic range compression.
summary.zh: 推导时变全极点滤波器的高效梯度，并应用于移相器、合成器和动态范围压缩。

papers.title: Data-Driven Room Acoustic Modeling Via Differentiable Feedback Delay Networks With Learnable Delay Lines
papers.venue: EURASIP Journal on Audio, Speech, and Music Processing 2024

summary.en: Makes feedback-delay-network delay lengths learnable through differentiable approximations for data-driven reverberator design.
summary.zh: 通过可微近似学习反馈延迟网络的延迟长度，用于数据驱动的混响器设计。

papers.title: Modeling Analog Dynamic Range Compressors using Deep Learning and State-space Models

summary.en: Models analog dynamic range compressors with deep learning and state-space architectures that capture temporal behavior.
summary.zh: 使用深度学习与状态空间架构建模模拟动态范围压缩器的时序行为。

papers.title: End-to-End Amp Modeling: From Data to Controllable Guitar Amplifier Models

summary.en: Provides an end-to-end workflow for building controllable neural guitar amplifier models from recorded data.
summary.zh: 提供从录制数据构建可控神经吉他音箱模型的端到端流程。

papers.title: NIIRF: Neural IIR Filter Field for HRTF Upsampling and Personalization

summary.en: Models HRTFs as a direction-conditioned field of stable neural IIR filters for upsampling and personalization.
summary.zh: 将 HRTF 建模为方向条件下的稳定神经 IIR 滤波器场，用于上采样与个性化。

rationale.en: Combines neural fields with stable IIR filters for a technically coherent HRTF model, with substantive evaluation and released code.
rationale.zh: 将神经场与稳定 IIR 滤波器结合形成完整 HRTF 模型，并提供充分实验与开源代码。

papers.title: Optimizing tiny colorless feedback delay networks
papers.venue: EURASIP Journal on Audio, Speech, and Music Processing 2025

summary.en: Optimizes feedback delay networks with differentiable frequency-domain processing to produce smooth, colorless reverberation.
summary.zh: 利用可微频域处理优化反馈延迟网络，以生成平滑、低染色的人工混响。

papers.title: Cross-modal Generative Model for Visual-Guided Binaural Stereo Generation

summary.en: Generates binaural stereo from mono audio with a cross-modal generative model conditioned on visual spatial information.
summary.zh: 通过以视觉空间信息为条件的跨模态生成模型，将单声道音频转换为双耳立体声。

papers.title: HRTF Interpolation using a Spherical Neural Process Meta-Learner

summary.en: Uses a spherical neural-process meta-learner to adapt HRTF interpolation from sparse subject-specific measurements.
summary.zh: 使用球面神经过程元学习器，根据稀疏的个体测量自适应 HRTF 插值。

papers.title: Blind estimation of audio effects using an auto-encoder approach and differentiable digital signal processing

summary.en: Combines an autoencoder with differentiable DSP to estimate audio effects and their controls without known settings.
summary.zh: 结合自编码器与可微 DSP，在未知设置的情况下估计音频效果及其控制参数。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Noise Reduction with Differentiable Signal Processing

summary.en: Combines a differentiable signal model with neural estimation for high-fidelity broadband audio denoising.
summary.zh: 结合可微信号模型与神经估计，实现高保真宽带音频降噪。

papers.title: Head-Related Transfer Function Interpolation with a Spherical CNN

summary.en: Interpolates personalized HRTFs on the sphere with a spherical convolutional neural network.
summary.zh: 使用球面卷积神经网络在球面上插值个体化 HRTF。

papers.title: Vocal Timbre Effects with Differentiable Digital Signal Processing

summary.en: Explores differentiable harmonic-plus-noise synthesis and autoencoding as creative vocal-timbre effects.
summary.zh: 探索可微谐波加噪声合成与自编码方法，用于创造性人声音色处理。

papers.title: A Differentiable Digital Moog Filter for Machine Learning Applications

summary.en: Derives parameter gradients for a digital Moog ladder filter so it can be embedded in machine-learning systems.
summary.zh: 推导数字 Moog 梯形滤波器对控制参数的梯度，使其可嵌入机器学习系统。

papers.title: General Purpose Audio Effect Removal

summary.en: Introduces RemFX, a general-purpose system for removing multiple audio effects from processed signals.
summary.zh: 提出通用音效去除系统 RemFX，用于从已处理信号中移除多种音频效果。

papers.title: A Review of Differentiable Digital Signal Processing for Music & Speech Synthesis

summary.en: Reviews differentiable digital signal processing for audio synthesis, effects, and music-production applications.
summary.zh: 综述可微分数字信号处理在音频合成、音效与音乐制作中的应用。

papers.title: Spatial LibriSpeech: An Augmented Dataset for Spatial Audio Learning

summary.en: Introduces a 650-hour synthetic first-order Ambisonic speech dataset with source, room, and geometry labels for spatial-audio learning.
summary.zh: 提出 650 小时的一阶 Ambisonics 合成语音数据集，包含声源、房间与几何标注，用于空间音频学习。

rationale.en: Provides a large, richly annotated Ambisonic corpus with a transparent generation process and direct public access for reproducible research.
rationale.zh: 提供大规模、丰富标注的 Ambisonics 语料，生成流程透明且可直接获取，支持可复现研究。

papers.title: Spatial Upsampling of Head-Related Transfer Functions Using a Physics-Informed Neural Network

summary.en: Uses a physics-informed neural network to spatially upsample sparse HRTF measurements.
summary.zh: 使用物理信息神经网络对稀疏 HRTF 测量进行空间上采样。

papers.title: HRTF upsampling with a generative adversarial network using a gnomonic equiangular projection

summary.en: Upsamples sparse individualized HRTFs with a GAN operating on a gnomonic equiangular projection.
summary.zh: 使用作用于球心等角投影的生成对抗网络，对稀疏个体化 HRTF 进行上采样。

papers.title: Differentiable Grey-box Modelling of Phaser Effects using Frame-based Spectral Processing

summary.en: Builds an interpretable differentiable gray-box phaser whose modulation and filter behavior are learned from audio.
summary.zh: 构建可解释的可微灰盒移相器，从音频中学习调制信号与滤波行为。

papers.title: Differentiable Allpass Filters for Phase Response Estimation and Automatic Signal Alignment

summary.en: Optimizes a differentiable allpass filter to align phase between related audio signals while preserving magnitude response.
summary.zh: 通过优化可微全通滤波器，在保持幅度响应的同时对齐相关音频信号的相位。

papers.title: Blind Estimation of Audio Processing Graph

summary.en: Blindly estimates the structure and processing choices of an audio production graph from rendered audio.
summary.zh: 从渲染后的音频中盲估计音频制作处理图的结构与处理配置。

papers.title: AV-NeRF: Learning Neural Fields for Real-World Audio-Visual Scene Synthesis

summary.en: Learns an audio-visual neural field that synthesizes matching views and spatial audio at novel listener positions and directions.
summary.zh: 学习音视频神经场，在新的听者位置和朝向合成匹配的画面与空间音频。

rationale.en: Defines novel-position audio-visual scene synthesis, develops a unified neural-field method, and releases code and supporting resources.
rationale.zh: 定义新位置音视频场景合成任务，提出统一神经场方法，并公开代码和配套资源。

papers.title: Listen2Scene: Interactive material-aware binaural sound propagation for reconstructed 3D scenes
papers.venue: IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces 2024

summary.en: Generates interactive binaural sound propagation for reconstructed indoor scenes using geometry and material information.
summary.zh: 利用重建室内场景的几何与材质信息，生成可交互的双耳声传播效果。

papers.title: DopplerBAS: Binaural Audio Synthesis Addressing Doppler Effect
papers.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2023

summary.en: Adds motion-aware Doppler modeling to binaural audio synthesis for moving sound sources.
summary.zh: 在双耳音频合成中加入面向运动声源的多普勒效应建模。

papers.title: Binaural Rendering of Ambisonic Signals by Neural Networks

summary.en: Learns binaural rendering of Ambisonic signals from paired Ambisonic and binaural recordings as an alternative to explicit HRTFs.
summary.zh: 从成对的 Ambisonics 与双耳录音中学习双耳渲染，作为显式 HRTF 方法的替代方案。

papers.title: Music Mixing Style Transfer: A Contrastive Learning Approach to Disentangle Audio Effects

summary.en: Learns contrastive representations that separate production effects from content for music mixing style transfer.
summary.zh: 通过对比学习分离制作效果与内容表征，用于音乐混音风格迁移。

rationale.en: Combines contrastive production-effect representations with multitrack and mixture-wise transfer in a unified mixing-style framework.
rationale.zh: 在统一的混音风格框架中结合制作音效对比表征、多轨迁移与混合音频迁移。

papers.title: Neural Fourier Shift for Binaural Speech Rendering

summary.en: Renders binaural speech from mono audio and source pose using a neural Fourier-domain shifting operation.
summary.zh: 利用神经傅里叶域移位操作，根据单声道音频和声源姿态渲染双耳语音。

papers.title: HRTF Field: Unifying Measured HRTF Magnitude Representation with Neural Fields

summary.en: Represents measured HRTF magnitudes as a continuous neural field over source direction for compact interpolation.
summary.zh: 将测得的 HRTF 幅度表示为关于声源方向的连续神经场，用于紧凑插值。

papers.title: A Method for Matching Room Impulse Responses with Feedback Delay Networks

summary.en: Fits a feedback delay network to target room impulse responses with feature extraction and genetic optimization, evaluated using OpenAIR responses.
summary.zh: 结合特征提取与遗传优化，使反馈延迟网络匹配目标房间脉冲响应，并使用 OpenAIR 响应进行评估。

papers.title: Reverse Engineering Memoryless Distortion Effects with Differentiable Waveshapers

summary.en: Estimates interpretable memoryless distortion curves by optimizing differentiable waveshaping models against target audio.
summary.zh: 通过目标音频优化可微波形整形模型，估计可解释的无记忆失真曲线。

papers.title: Approximating Ballistics in a Differentiable Dynamic Range Compressor

summary.en: Develops a differentiable approximation to compressor attack and release ballistics for gradient-based parameter recovery.
summary.zh: 构建压缩器起音与释放动态的可微近似，用于基于梯度的参数恢复。

papers.title: A Direct Microdynamics Adjusting Processor with Matching Paradigm and Differentiable Implementation

summary.en: Introduces a differentiable processor for directly matching and adjusting short-term signal dynamics.
summary.zh: 提出可微处理器，用于直接匹配与调整音频信号的短时动态。

papers.title: Grey-Box Modelling of Dynamic Range Compression

summary.en: Fits a lightweight, interpretable gray-box compressor model to measured dynamic-range-compression behavior.
summary.zh: 使用轻量、可解释的灰盒压缩器模型拟合实测动态范围压缩行为。

papers.title: Automatic music mixing with deep learning and out-of-domain data

summary.en: Develops automatic music mixing with deep learning while using out-of-domain processed audio for training.
summary.zh: 研究使用域外已处理音频训练深度学习自动音乐混音系统。

papers.title: Head-Related Transfer Function Interpolation from Spatially Sparse Measurements Using Autoencoder with Source Position Conditioning
papers.venue: International Workshop on Acoustic Signal Enhancement 2022

summary.en: Interpolates HRTFs from sparse measurements using an autoencoder conditioned on source position.
summary.zh: 使用以声源位置为条件的自编码器，从稀疏测量结果插值 HRTF。

papers.title: Style Transfer of Audio Effects with Differentiable Signal Processing

summary.en: Transfers production style from reference audio by controlling a chain of differentiable audio effects.
summary.zh: 通过控制可微分音频效果链，将参考音频中的制作风格迁移到目标音频。

rationale.en: Establishes self-supervised audio-effect style transfer through differentiable processors while retaining interpretable effect controls.
rationale.zh: 通过可微分效果器实现自监督音效风格迁移，同时保留可解释的效果控制。

papers.title: End-to-End Binaural Speech Synthesis

summary.en: Combines a neural audio codec and binaural decoder for end-to-end speech binauralization with environmental reconstruction.
summary.zh: 结合神经音频编码器与双耳解码器，实现包含环境重建的端到端语音双耳化。

papers.title: Emulating Diode Circuits with Differentiable Wave Digital Filters

summary.en: Trains differentiable wave digital filters to emulate nonlinear diode circuits used in audio effects.
summary.zh: 训练可微波数字滤波器，以模拟音频效果器中的非线性二极管电路。

papers.title: BinauralGrad: A Two-Stage Conditional Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Binaural Audio Synthesis

summary.en: Synthesizes binaural audio from mono input and source trajectories with a two-stage conditional diffusion model.
summary.zh: 使用两阶段条件扩散模型，根据单声道输入和声源轨迹合成双耳音频。

rationale.en: Introduces a coherent two-stage diffusion formulation for binaural synthesis, validates spatial fidelity, and provides an official implementation.
rationale.zh: 提出完整的两阶段双耳合成扩散框架，验证空间保真度，并提供官方实现。

papers.title: Global HRTF Interpolation via Learned Affine Transformation of Hyper-conditioned Features

summary.en: Interpolates individualized HRTFs at arbitrary source positions with learned affine transformations of direction-conditioned features.
summary.zh: 通过对方向条件特征进行学习式仿射变换，插值任意声源位置的个体化 HRTF。

papers.title: Upmixing via style transfer: a variational autoencoder for disentangling spatial images and musical content

summary.en: Uses a variational autoencoder to separate musical content from spatial image and transfer directionality for stereo-to-multichannel music upmixing.
summary.zh: 使用变分自编码器解耦音乐内容与空间声像，并迁移方向性以实现立体声到多声道音乐上混。

papers.title: End-to-end Music Remastering System Using Self-supervised and Adversarial Training

summary.en: Presents an end-to-end music remastering system trained with self-supervised and adversarial objectives.
summary.zh: 提出采用自监督与对抗学习目标训练的端到端音乐再母带系统。

papers.title: Distortion Audio Effects: Learning How to Recover the Clean Signal

summary.en: Studies neural recovery of clean audio from signals processed by nonlinear distortion effects.
summary.zh: 研究如何利用神经网络从经过非线性失真效果处理的信号中恢复干净音频。

papers.title: MIDI-DDSP: Detailed Control of Musical Performance via Hierarchical Modeling

rationale.en: MIDI-DDSP establishes an editable note-performance-synthesis hierarchy, validates independent control through quantitative and listening experiments, and provides code, demos, training instructions, and pretrained weights.
rationale.zh: MIDI-DDSP 建立可编辑的音符、演奏、合成三层结构，通过客观与听音实验验证独立控制，并公开代码、演示、训练说明和预训练权重。

summary.en: MIDI-DDSP organizes musical generation into editable note, performance, and DDSP synthesis levels, allowing users to manipulate expressive attributes or rely on learned priors between stages.
summary.zh: MIDI-DDSP 将音乐生成组织为可编辑的音符、演奏和 DDSP 合成三层，使用户能够调节表情属性，或使用阶段之间的学习先验。

papers.title: Dataset of Spatial Room Impulse Responses in a Variable Acoustics Room for Six Degrees-of-Freedom Rendering and Analysis

summary.en: Documents a multi-position, variable-acoustics spatial room impulse response dataset for six-degrees-of-freedom rendering and analysis.
summary.zh: 记录一个多位置、可变声学条件的空间房间脉冲响应数据集，用于六自由度渲染与分析。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Multi-Task Learning for Binaural Audio Generation from Video

summary.en: Uses geometry-aware auxiliary tasks and visual information to spatialize monaural video audio into binaural output.
summary.zh: 利用几何感知辅助任务和视觉信息，将单声道视频音频空间化为双耳输出。

papers.title: Beyond Mono to Binaural: Generating Binaural Audio from Mono Audio with Depth and Cross Modal Attention
papers.venue: IEEE Workshop/Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2022

summary.en: Conditions mono-to-binaural generation on visual depth and cross-modal attention to recover spatial cues from video.
summary.zh: 利用视觉深度和跨模态注意力约束单声道到双耳音频生成，以恢复视频中的空间线索。

papers.title: Automatic DJ Transitions with Differentiable Audio Effects and Generative Adversarial Networks

summary.en: Generates automatic DJ transitions with differentiable equalizer and fader modules inside an adversarial model.
summary.zh: 在对抗生成模型中加入可微均衡器与推子模块，用于自动生成 DJ 转场。

papers.title: Direct design of biquad filter cascades with deep learning by sampling random polynomials

summary.en: Trains a neural model to design stable cascaded biquad filters directly from desired frequency responses.
summary.zh: 训练神经模型根据目标频率响应直接设计稳定的级联双二阶滤波器。

papers.title: Differentiable White-Box Virtual Analog Modeling

summary.en: Differentiates through explicit virtual-analog circuit models so physical parameters can be learned from audio.
summary.zh: 对显式虚拟模拟电路模型求导，使物理参数能够从音频中学习。

papers.title: Binaural Audio Generation via Multi-task Learning

summary.en: Combines binaural generation with auxiliary flipped-audio classification in a multi-task model for mono-to-binaural conversion.
summary.zh: 在多任务模型中结合双耳生成与翻转音频分类，用于单声道到双耳音频的转换。

papers.title: Reverse Engineering of a Recording Mix with Differentiable Digital Signal Processing
papers.venue: Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 2021

summary.en: Recovers a recording mix by optimizing the controls of a differentiable multitrack processing chain.
summary.zh: 通过优化可微多轨处理链的控制参数，逆向恢复录音混音。

papers.title: MeshRIR: A Dataset of Room Impulse Responses on Meshed Grid Points For Evaluating Sound Field Analysis and Synthesis Methods

summary.en: Introduces densely measured room impulse responses on meshed grids for evaluating sound-field analysis, interpolation, and synthesis.
summary.zh: 提供网格点上的密集房间脉冲响应测量，用于评估声场分析、插值与合成方法。

papers.title: Differentiable Artificial Reverberation

summary.en: Formulates artificial reverberation as differentiable signal processing and optimizes reverberator parameters from data.
summary.zh: 将人工混响表述为可微信号处理，并从数据中优化混响器参数。

papers.title: Differentiable Signal Processing With Black-Box Audio Effects

summary.en: Learns differentiable proxy models for black-box audio effects so their parameters can be optimized with gradients.
summary.zh: 为黑盒音频效果器学习可微代理模型，使效果参数能够通过梯度进行优化。

rationale.en: Makes black-box audio effects trainable through differentiable proxy and gradient-approximation strategies across practical production applications.
rationale.zh: 通过可微分代理与梯度近似使黑盒音效可训练，并覆盖多种实际音频制作应用。

papers.title: Neural Synthesis of Binaural Speech from Mono Audio

summary.en: Renders binaural speech from mono audio and tracked source-listener geometry with a neural sound renderer.
summary.zh: 使用神经声音渲染器，根据单声道音频及跟踪的声源与听者几何信息生成双耳语音。

papers.title: Exploiting Audio-Visual Consistency with Partial Supervision for Spatial Audio Generation

summary.en: Uses audio-visual consistency and partially supervised binaural data to spatialize monaural video audio.
summary.zh: 利用音视频一致性和部分双耳监督数据，将单声道视频音频空间化。

papers.title: Visually Informed Binaural Audio Generation without Binaural Audios

summary.en: Learns visually guided binaural generation without requiring real binaural recordings by constructing pseudo-binaural supervision.
summary.zh: 通过构造伪双耳监督，在不依赖真实双耳录音的情况下学习视觉引导的双耳音频生成。

papers.title: Lightweight and interpretable neural modeling of an audio distortion effect using hyperconditioned differentiable biquads

summary.en: Uses differentiable biquad filters inside a neural model to emulate nonlinear distortion with an interpretable filtering stage.
summary.zh: 在神经模型中使用可微双二阶滤波器，以带有可解释滤波阶段的结构模拟非线性失真。

papers.title: Guitar Effects Recognition and Parameter Estimation with Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.venue: Journal of the Audio Engineering Society, 2021

summary.en: Uses convolutional neural networks to recognize guitar effects and estimate their parameter settings from audio.
summary.zh: 使用卷积神经网络从音频中识别吉他效果器，并估计其参数设置。

papers.title: Automatic multitrack mixing with a differentiable mixing console of neural audio effects

summary.en: Introduces an end-to-end automatic mixing system built around a differentiable console of neural audio effects.
summary.zh: 提出由神经音频效果器构成的可微分混音台，用于端到端自动多轨混音。

rationale.en: Presents an early end-to-end automatic multitrack mixing system built around a differentiable mixing console.
rationale.zh: 较早提出以可微分调音台为核心的端到端自动多轨混音系统。

papers.title: Neural Parametric Equalizer Matching Using Differentiable Biquads

summary.en: Predicts parametric-equalizer settings with a neural network trained through differentiable biquad filters.
summary.zh: 通过可微双二阶滤波器训练神经网络，以预测参数均衡器设置。

papers.title: Differentiable IIR Filters for Machine Learning Applications

summary.en: Compares differentiable IIR topologies designed for inclusion in end-to-end machine-learning systems.
summary.zh: 比较可嵌入端到端机器学习系统的多种可微 IIR 滤波器结构。

papers.title: Sep-Stereo: Visually Guided Stereophonic Audio Generation by Associating Source Separation

summary.en: Generates stereophonic audio from mono video by coupling visual guidance with source separation under self-supervision.
summary.zh: 结合视觉引导与声源分离，以自监督方式从单声道视频生成立体声音频。

papers.title: DDSP: Differentiable Digital Signal Processing

summary.en: Introduces differentiable digital signal processing modules that combine interpretable DSP structure with neural-network training.
summary.zh: 提出可微分数字信号处理模块，将可解释的 DSP 结构与神经网络训练结合。

rationale.en: Establishes a foundational framework that integrates interpretable digital signal-processing modules with deep learning and supports broad downstream use.
rationale.zh: 建立将可解释数字信号处理模块与深度学习结合的基础框架，并支持广泛的后续应用。

papers.title: Cutting Music Source Separation Some Slakh: A Dataset to Study the Impact of Training Data Quality and Quantity

summary.en: Introduces Slakh2100 and benchmarks its synthetic multitracks and stems for data-intensive music source separation.
summary.zh: 提出 Slakh2100，并通过基准实验评估其合成多轨与分轨数据在数据密集型音乐源分离中的作用。

papers.title: 2.5D Visual Sound

summary.en: Uses visual scene information to convert monaural video audio into binaural sound and introduces the FAIR-Play dataset.
summary.zh: 利用视频场景信息将单声道音频转换为双耳音频，并提出 FAIR-Play 数据集。

rationale.en: Establishes a clear visual-to-binaural task with substantive evaluation and releases both code and the FAIR-Play dataset.
rationale.zh: 建立清晰的视觉到双耳音频任务，进行了充分实验，并公开代码与 FAIR-Play 数据集。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Generation of Spatial Audio for 360 Video

summary.en: Learns to generate spatial audio for 360-degree video with self-supervision from large video collections.
summary.zh: 利用大规模视频集合进行自监督学习，为 360 度视频生成空间音频。

papers.title: VIOLET: High-Fidelity Violin Synthesis with Techniques and Dynamics

rationale.en: VIOLET extends controllable performance rendering beyond piano with explicit violin techniques, high-fidelity synthesis, and public code and dataset resources.
rationale.zh: VIOLET 将可控演奏渲染扩展到钢琴之外，以明确小提琴技法实现高保真合成，并公开代码与数据资源。

summary.en: VIOLET synthesizes violin audio from symbolic control with explicit playing techniques and dynamics, supported by a newly released technique-rich dataset.
summary.zh: VIOLET 根据带有明确演奏技法与力度控制的符号输入合成小提琴音频，并发布技法丰富的新数据集。

papers.title: DDSynth-RL: Audio Synthesizer Inversion via Discrete Diffusion with Reinforcement Learning

rationale.en: DDSynth-RL introduces a technically distinct discrete-diffusion formulation for large preset spaces and releases code, evaluation tools, and checkpoints under explicit licenses.
rationale.zh: DDSynth-RL 为大规模预设空间提出技术上独特的离散扩散方案，并在明确许可证下公开代码、评测工具和权重。

summary.en: DDSynth-RL treats synthesizer inversion as discrete diffusion over preset parameters and uses reinforcement learning to align generated presets with target audio.
summary.zh: DDSynth-RL 将合成器反演建模为预设参数上的离散扩散，并使用强化学习使生成预设与目标音频对齐。

papers.title: PianoKontext: Expressive Performance Rendering from Deadpan Context

summary.en: PianoKontext renders expressive piano performance from deadpan symbolic context and explores how surrounding musical context guides local expression.
summary.zh: PianoKontext 从无表情的符号上下文渲染表现力钢琴演奏，并研究周边音乐语境如何引导局部表情。

papers.title: RenCon 2025: Revival of the Expressive Performance Rendering Competition

summary.en: RenCon 2025 revives the expressive performance rendering challenge with shared repertoire, submission rules, and human evaluation for comparing systems.
summary.zh: RenCon 2025 通过共享曲目、提交规则和人工评价重启表现力演奏渲染竞赛，为系统比较提供统一条件。

papers.title: Pianist Transformer: Towards Expressive Piano Performance Rendering via Scalable Self-Supervised Pre-Training

rationale.en: Pianist Transformer combines scalable self-supervised pretraining, strong rendering results, editable symbolic outputs, and a complete release with code, checkpoints, and training recipes.
rationale.zh: Pianist Transformer 结合可扩展自监督预训练、强渲染结果和可编辑符号输出，并完整公开代码、权重与训练流程。

summary.en: Pianist Transformer scales expressive performance rendering through self-supervised pretraining on symbolic piano data and supports downstream generation and editing tasks.
summary.zh: Pianist Transformer 通过大规模符号钢琴数据上的自监督预训练扩展表现力演奏渲染，并支持后续生成与编辑任务。

papers.title: Disentangling Score Content and Performance Style for Joint Piano Rendering and Transcription

rationale.en: JointPianist connects rendering and transcription through an explicit content-style factorization and reports strong bidirectional results with a public interactive project page.
rationale.zh: JointPianist 通过显式内容与风格分解连接渲染和转录，在双向任务上取得强结果，并提供公开交互项目页。

summary.en: JointPianist disentangles score content from performance style in a shared framework that supports both expressive piano rendering and automatic transcription.
summary.zh: JointPianist 在统一框架中分离乐谱内容与演奏风格，同时支持表现力钢琴渲染和自动转录。

papers.title: MixAssist: An Audio-Language Dataset for Co-Creative AI Assistance in Music Mixing

rationale.en: MixAssist defines a concrete co-creative mixing-assistance task, releases a purpose-built audio-language dataset, and provides evaluation, training, and adapter resources.
rationale.zh: MixAssist 定义了具体的人机协同混音助手任务，公开专用音频语言数据集，并提供评测、训练和适配器资源。

summary.en: MixAssist pairs audio, mixing context, and natural-language feedback to train and evaluate assistants that suggest concrete, context-aware mix edits.
summary.zh: MixAssist 将音频、混音上下文和自然语言反馈配对，用于训练和评估能够提出具体情境化混音修改建议的助手。

papers.title: TOMI: Transforming and Organizing Music Ideas for Multi-Track Compositions with Full-Song Structure

rationale.en: TOMI introduces a structured representation for full-song multitrack arrangement, demonstrates coherent long-form generation, and provides a working REAPER-integrated implementation.
rationale.zh: TOMI 为完整歌曲的多轨编曲提出结构化表示，展示连贯长结构生成，并提供可运行的 REAPER 集成实现。

summary.en: TOMI represents full songs through clips, sections, tracks, and transformations, then uses an LLM and sample retrieval to construct editable multitrack arrangements inside REAPER.
summary.zh: TOMI 以片段、段落、轨道和变换表示完整歌曲，再通过 LLM 与素材检索在 REAPER 中构建可编辑多轨编曲。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Predict Audio Effects Parameters from Natural Language?

rationale.en: LLM2Fx establishes a direct language-to-effect-parameter task across real production processors and releases a reusable tool-calling framework for further evaluation.
rationale.zh: LLM2Fx 在真实制作处理器上建立语言到效果参数的直接任务，并公开可复用工具调用框架支持后续评测。

summary.en: LLM2Fx evaluates whether language models can translate production instructions into executable audio-effect parameter settings across common processors.
summary.zh: LLM2Fx 评估语言模型能否将制作指令转化为常见音频处理器上可执行的效果参数设置。

papers.title: RenderBox: Expressive Performance Rendering with Text Control

summary.en: RenderBox conditions expressive performance rendering on natural-language descriptions, connecting high-level musical intent to editable symbolic performance output.
summary.zh: RenderBox 使用自然语言描述作为表现力演奏渲染条件，将高层音乐意图连接到可编辑的符号演奏输出。

papers.title: Annotation-Free MIDI-to-Audio Synthesis via Concatenative Synthesis and Generative Refinement

summary.en: CoSaRef creates aligned MIDI-audio supervision through concatenative synthesis and then refines the result with a generative audio model, avoiding manually aligned recordings.
summary.zh: CoSaRef 先通过拼接合成构造 MIDI 与音频对齐监督，再使用生成模型细化音频，从而避免人工对齐录音。

papers.title: Sound Matching Using Synthesizer Ensembles

summary.en: This work matches target sounds with ensembles of synthesizer instances, expanding the achievable timbre space beyond a single preset or instrument.
summary.zh: 该工作使用多个合成器实例组成的集成来匹配目标声音，将可实现音色空间扩展到单一预设或乐器之外。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Code Generation for Audio Programming with Visual Dataflow Languages

summary.en: The benchmark evaluates whether language models can generate executable visual dataflow audio programs, testing both structural correctness and rendered behavior.
summary.zh: 该基准评估语言模型能否生成可执行的可视化数据流音频程序，同时检验结构正确性和实际渲染行为。

papers.title: Combining audio control and style transfer using latent diffusion

rationale.en: The work unifies explicit MIDI or audio structure control with example-based timbre transfer, reports broad quantitative evaluation, and has both a reproducible research release and a real-time Ableton/Max implementation.
rationale.zh: 该工作统一 MIDI 或音频结构控制与示例音色迁移，进行了广泛量化评测，并同时提供可复现研究代码和 Ableton/Max 实时实现。

summary.en: A latent diffusion model separates time-varying musical structure from global timbre, supporting MIDI-to-audio rendering, audio-guided control, and one-shot timbre transfer.
summary.zh: 该潜扩散模型分离时变音乐结构与全局音色，支持 MIDI 到音频渲染、音频引导控制和单样本音色迁移。

papers.title: Synthesizer Sound Matching Using Audio Spectrogram Transformers

summary.en: The method adapts Audio Spectrogram Transformers to infer synthesizer parameters from target timbres and evaluates reconstruction across preset distributions.
summary.zh: 该方法将音频频谱 Transformer 用于从目标音色推断合成器参数，并在不同预设分布上评估重建效果。

papers.title: DExter: Learning and Controlling Performance Expression with Diffusion Models

rationale.en: DExter offers a coherent diffusion formulation for expressive performance, direct control over musical attributes, broad evaluation, and released training and inference code.
rationale.zh: DExter 为表现力演奏提出完整扩散建模方案，支持音乐属性直接控制，并公开训练和推理代码及充分评测。

summary.en: DExter applies diffusion modeling to expressive piano performance and supports controllable generation through global and local performance descriptors.
summary.zh: DExter 将扩散模型用于表现力钢琴演奏，并通过全局和局部演奏描述符支持可控生成。

papers.title: Creative Text-to-Audio Generation via Synthesizer Programming

rationale.en: CTAG links language, modular signal-flow programs, and evolutionary optimization in an explicitly editable generation process, with a public functional implementation.
rationale.zh: CTAG 在明确可编辑的生成流程中连接语言、模块化信号流程序和进化优化，并公开可运行实现。

summary.en: CTAG converts text descriptions into modular synthesizer programs and improves them with evolutionary search, producing editable signal graphs rather than opaque audio alone.
summary.zh: CTAG 将文本描述转化为模块化合成器程序，并通过进化搜索优化，输出可编辑信号图而非仅生成不可解释音频。

papers.title: ScorePerformer: Expressive Piano Performance Rendering with Fine-Grained Control

rationale.en: ScorePerformer combines competitive expressive rendering with unusually fine-grained editable controls and a public implementation under explicit research-oriented terms.
rationale.zh: ScorePerformer 将有竞争力的表现力渲染与细粒度可编辑控制结合，并在明确的研究用途条款下公开实现。

summary.en: ScorePerformer uses a score-aware Transformer to render piano performances while exposing fine-grained timing, dynamics, and articulation controls.
summary.zh: ScorePerformer 使用乐谱感知 Transformer 渲染钢琴演奏，并提供细粒度时值、力度和奏法控制。

papers.title: Synthesizer Preset Interpolation Using Transformer Auto-Encoders

rationale.en: SPINVAE treats preset interpolation as a joint audio-parameter representation problem and provides a substantial open implementation with training code and downloadable models.
rationale.zh: SPINVAE 将预设插值建模为音频与参数联合表征问题，并提供包含训练代码和可下载模型的完整开源实现。

summary.en: SPINVAE learns a structured latent space for synthesizer presets and audio, enabling interpolation between editable presets while retaining timbral continuity.
summary.zh: SPINVAE 学习合成器预设与音频的结构化潜空间，在保持音色连续性的同时实现可编辑预设间插值。

papers.title: Can Knowledge of End-to-End Text-to-Speech Models Improve Neural MIDI-to-Audio Synthesis Systems?

summary.en: The study transfers architectures and training lessons from end-to-end speech synthesis to neural MIDI-to-piano-audio rendering and releases a reproducible implementation.
summary.zh: 该研究将端到端语音合成的架构和训练经验迁移到 MIDI 到钢琴音频渲染，并公开可复现实现。

papers.title: Differentiable Piano Model for MIDI-to-Audio Performance Synthesis

rationale.en: DDSP-Piano combines interpretable instrument-informed synthesis with polyphonic MIDI control, won the DAFx 2022 best-paper award, and provides code, weights, training, and evaluation tools.
rationale.zh: DDSP-Piano 将可解释的乐器知识合成与复音 MIDI 控制结合，获得 DAFx 2022 最佳论文，并公开代码、权重、训练和评测工具。

summary.en: DDSP-Piano combines additive, subtractive, and reverberation components in a differentiable polyphonic synthesizer conditioned on MIDI notes, velocity, pedals, and piano identity.
summary.zh: DDSP-Piano 将加法、减法与混响组件组合为可微分复音合成器，并以 MIDI 音符、力度、踏板和钢琴身份为条件。

papers.title: Sketching the Expression: Flexible Rendering of Expressive Piano Performance with Self-Supervised Learning

summary.en: The model learns interpretable expression sketches from performance data and lets users transfer or edit broad timing and dynamics contours during rendering.
summary.zh: 该模型从演奏数据学习可解释的表情轮廓，使用户能够在渲染时迁移或编辑整体时值和力度走向。

papers.title: Sound2Synth: Interpreting Sound via FM Synthesizer Parameters Estimation

summary.en: Sound2Synth predicts interpretable FM synthesizer parameters from audio so that target timbres can be reconstructed and edited with a known signal generator.
summary.zh: Sound2Synth 从音频预测可解释的 FM 合成器参数，使目标音色能够由已知信号生成器重建并继续编辑。

papers.title: Deep Performer: Score-to-Audio Music Performance Synthesis

summary.en: Deep Performer synthesizes expressive piano audio directly from a score-conditioned pianoroll using a convolutional generator and adversarial training.
summary.zh: Deep Performer 以乐谱条件钢琴卷帘为输入，通过卷积生成器和对抗训练直接合成具有表现力的钢琴音频。

papers.title: DawDreamer: Bridging the Gap Between Digital Audio Workstations and Python Interfaces

rationale.en: DawDreamer provides mature, practical infrastructure for programmable DAW graphs and plug-in automation, with a substantial open-source implementation used across later research pipelines.
rationale.zh: DawDreamer 为可编程 DAW 图和插件自动化提供成熟实用基础设施，其完整开源实现已被后续多项研究流程采用。

summary.en: DawDreamer exposes DAW-style plug-in graphs, automation, synthesis, and offline rendering through Python, enabling reproducible programmatic production workflows.
summary.zh: DawDreamer 通过 Python 提供 DAW 式插件图、自动化、合成和离线渲染接口，使制作流程可以程序化复现。

papers.title: Quality Diversity for Synthesizer Sound Matching

summary.en: The method uses quality-diversity search to return multiple perceptually similar but parametrically diverse synthesizer presets for one target sound.
summary.zh: 该方法使用质量多样性搜索，为同一目标声音返回感知相似但参数配置多样的合成器预设。

papers.title: SerumRNN: Step by Step Audio VST Effect Programming

summary.en: SerumRNN models synthesizer programming as a sequence of parameter edits, making the path from target sound to a reproducible preset explicit.
summary.zh: SerumRNN 将合成器编程建模为一系列参数编辑，使从目标声音到可复现预设的操作路径更加明确。

papers.title: White-box Audio VST Effect Programming
papers.venue: NeurIPS 2020 ML for Creativity and Design Workshop

summary.en: This work predicts editable VST synthesizer parameters from target audio in a white-box setting and studies the effect of sequential parameter programming.
summary.zh: 该工作在白盒设置下从目标音频预测可编辑 VST 合成器参数，并研究逐步参数编程的效果。

papers.title: Generative Modelling for Controllable Audio Synthesis of Expressive Piano Performance

summary.en: A Gaussian-mixture VAE renders piano audio from symbolic input while exposing time-varying articulation and dynamics controls for performance style morphing.
summary.zh: 该高斯混合 VAE 从符号输入渲染钢琴音频，并通过时变奏法与力度控制实现演奏风格渐变。

papers.title: VirtuosoNet: A Hierarchical RNN-based System for Modeling Expressive Piano Performance

rationale.en: VirtuosoNet established a widely reused hierarchical baseline for expressive performance rendering and provides maintained inference code and pretrained models.
rationale.zh: VirtuosoNet 建立了被广泛复用的层级式表现力演奏基线，并提供持续维护的推理代码和预训练模型。

summary.en: VirtuosoNet models note-, beat-, and measure-level score structure to generate expressive piano performances from symbolic scores.
summary.zh: VirtuosoNet 对音符、拍和小节层级的乐谱结构建模，从符号乐谱生成具有表现力的钢琴演奏。

papers.title: Rendering Music Performance With Interpretation Variations Using Conditional Variational RNN

summary.en: A conditional variational recurrent model generates multiple plausible expressive interpretations of the same score instead of a single deterministic performance.
summary.zh: 该条件变分循环模型为同一份乐谱生成多种合理的表现力诠释，而非单一确定性演奏。

papers.title: Universal Audio Synthesizer Control with Normalizing Flows

rationale.en: Flow Synthesizer introduced a reusable probabilistic control space across heterogeneous synthesizers and released code, data preparation, pretrained models, and interactive demonstrations.
rationale.zh: Flow Synthesizer 在异构合成器之间建立可复用概率控制空间，并公开代码、数据准备、预训练模型和交互演示。

summary.en: A normalizing-flow latent space maps audio descriptors to parameters across several synthesizer families, supporting interpolation and cross-instrument control.
summary.zh: 该工作使用归一化流潜空间在多类合成器之间映射音频描述与参数，支持插值和跨乐器控制。

papers.title: Graph Neural Network for Music Score Data and Modeling Expressive Piano Performance

summary.en: This work represents music scores as graphs and predicts expressive piano timing, dynamics, and articulation from structured score context.
summary.zh: 该工作将乐谱表示为图结构，并根据结构化乐谱上下文预测钢琴演奏的时值、力度和奏法。

papers.title: InverSynth: Deep Estimation of Synthesizer Parameter Configurations from Audio Signals

summary.en: InverSynth estimates synthesizer parameter configurations from target audio, framing sound matching as structured inverse control rather than waveform generation.
summary.zh: InverSynth 从目标音频估计合成器参数配置，将音色匹配表述为结构化逆向控制而非波形生成。

papers.title: PerformanceNet: Score-to-Audio Music Generation with Multi-Band Convolutional Residual Network

summary.en: PerformanceNet directly renders symbolic piano scores to audio with a multi-band convolutional residual network, jointly learning performance and synthesis characteristics.
summary.zh: PerformanceNet 使用多频带卷积残差网络将符号钢琴乐谱直接渲染为音频，同时学习演奏与合成特征。
